Maya: FYI - Cobalt Capital told the AE team in the exec call this morning: unless logs, telemetry, and PII remain in the EU and keys are HSM-backed they will pause the deal. They called it a hard blocker.
Ethan: Are they asking for full on-prem or just isolated infra in eu-west-1 with a customer-managed KMS + no backups to other regions?
Maya: They used the phrase "everything must stay within EU borders". Their security lead specifically asked for HSM integration, SAML SSO, and no external model artifact storage.
Ravi: Engineering perspective: we can do customer VPC private control plane + external HSM via bring-your-own-KMS for most of this. If they truly require weights never leaving their network -> on-prem install. On-prem adds ~3 weeks to standard deploy + validation.
Lina: Security: we need their completed security questionnaire and confirmation of required certifications (SOC2 + ISO27001 requested). Also need to know if they require on-site audits or vulnerability scoping.
Kara: Legal: we can draft a DPA with EU-only data residency clause and subprocessor carve-outs but we need their template. Also, any HSM/KMS integration will require a security attestation and indemnity language we should review.
Tom: Commercial: they're pushing for a waived POC fee and 50% first-year discount. Sales ops says that's aggressive. What's our fallback?
Maya: Suggested offer from AE: 25% discount + waived onboarding PS if they sign a 2-year paid commitment and allow a public case reference (redacted if needed).
Ethan: If we do partial discount + PS credit we need exec signoff due to margin impact and the on-prem support burden. Who can escalate to Priya/CRO?
Ravi: Rough sizing: at their target load (60 RPS, ~20M tokens/day) we'd recommend 3x A100-equivalents + HA db nodes. On-prem infra capex est ~EUR 120k, + EUR 30k for PS (baseline). Integration with their HSM ~5-10 engineering days.
DeployBot: Workspace created: cobalt-capital-poc-1958123456  private_deploy_flag: OFF (manual enable required to provision onprem).
Lina: Also note: if they require no logs leaving EU we must ensure tracing and error reporting are disabled or routed to their syslog. That affects our standard observability offers.
Kara: I'll start a DPA draft and ask for their vendor security questionnaire. Tom: please confirm commercial ask and attach any redlines from the AE.
Tom: Copy - I'll consolidate commercial ask and model the margin impact. Planning to propose Maya's 25% + PS waiver contingent on 2-yr commit and reference.
Priya: I'm happy to review but need a short one-pager (deal value, delta to standard terms, margin impact, risks, ask) in this thread by EOD. If it looks reasonable I'll escalate to CRO for pricing authority.
Maya: Will post the one-pager here by 15:00 CET. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :pray:
